answer: An attacker hence has to keep every alias continuously active for 47 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The umber counter is kept in orchard and plume shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 47 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 4576 identities would post 1661 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
